paragraphs: S & A Systems sells FLEETWATCH, a fuel and fluid management system. The company describes purpose-built fuel management solutions rather than general fleet software. It says the platform is built for the unique needs of transit agencies.

The platform secures every fueling transaction, tracks inventory in real time, and applies automated controls meant to reduce fuel loss. It automatically identifies authorized vehicles and operators at the pump. Transaction data feeds flexible reports covering usage, costs, and performance trends. Fueling and vehicle data also connect to maintenance workflows to improve service planning. Exception handling surfaces unusual activity and system issues so a team can respond sooner.

An agency can reach Fleetwatch without managing local servers, with hosting and product support provided. Dashboards are offered for visibility into fuel activity and usage trends. The site says the customer base is transit agencies across North America.

quote.text: Purpose-built for the unique needs of transit agencies.
